bootstrap_instruction: From a cold start, use FRESH_AGENT_BOOTSTRAP.md on main to resolve Issue #2, Draft PR #1 and branch design/industry-memory. Read Strategy and Method Core, independently reconstruct the mission, calibrate with mission-fidelity.json, then read this checkpoint and only the bounded active-state files. Refresh live HEAD/CI before mutation.

strategic_horizon.medium_term_goal: Prove the first real industry benchmark end-to-end: archived original evidence must support no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay across a meaningful cycle, using reusable primitives rather than lithium-specific hacks.
strategic_horizon.short_term_goal: Use the first legitimate sealed shard to prove the evidence-final transition. Preserve the lithium blind layer at 683 raw / 625 formal typed / 58 legacy, keep UP-CHEMICALS blind memory frozen, and start a new shard-scoped self-verification run that refines high-value Memory Leads into exact historical source targets without treating search results as facts.
strategic_horizon.next_big_step: Convert the first sealed-shard discovery results into claim-scoped evidence tasks, archive original sources with valid-time/known-time semantics, and build the first no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay slice while the other 13 unsealed shards remain search-isolated.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not reopen sealed blind memory merely because search finds better wording or later facts. Search is discovery, evidence decides truth, and unsealed shards remain blind. Stop verification work that does not improve exact source targeting, evidence traceability or the first replay slice.
parallel_permanent_tracks: Keep current-source collection source-first/archive-now so today's original material does not become tomorrow's recovery gap.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Validated the 683/625 checkpoint with CI #514, rebuilt the deterministic UP-CHEMICALS compact at 53 formal leads, performed an explicit ten-lens negative-space review, and found no material first-order replay gap. The review artifact passed the manifest rule: three consecutive low-novelty probes, coverage-matrix review and required long-tail categories. coverage-index now marks UP-CHEMICALS as the first sealed shard; the blind atlas remains immutable and no fresh search has yet been used.
continuation_cursor.current_task: Validate the synchronized first-seal checkpoint, then create a new self-verification run scoped only to UP-CHEMICALS. The new run may use fresh search for discovery, but must write outside blind/, must not rewrite sealed Memory Leads, and must prioritize exact dated primary-source targets for the 2019-2020 replay.
continuation_cursor.why_now: Blind recall has reached a legitimate stop condition on one first-order conversion shard. Continuing memory generation would now have lower value than testing whether sealed leads can be turned into precise evidence work without hindsight leakage.
continuation_cursor.done_when: A persisted UP-CHEMICALS self-verification run manifest names the sealed input checkpoint and search boundary, an initial high-capability discovery pass identifies exact companies/projects/documents or bounded unresolved claims, search outputs remain discovery-only, and the next claim-scoped evidence tasks are explicit. Repository hard gates remain green.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: Require green hard CI for the synchronized seal checkpoint. Then create a new UP-CHEMICALS self-verification run manifest that consumes the sealed 53-lead compact, freezes blind mutation, permits fresh discovery only for this shard, and selects a small set of 2019-2020 replay-critical claim families for the first search pass.
